title: WaiterX
tagline: A modular crypto WEB3 Telegram Web App, allowing new web3 user to have a simple gateway entry to crypto world.
description: The project is a Public Good based Telegram Web App - User friendly , that help new comers and intermediate WEB3 users to be able to have a safe way to Swap / Bridge and own a Wallet directly implemented into Telegram that makes it easy for anyone to access to the world of WEB3 using his phone or his PC though the Telegram app.
how_its_made: This project is a Next.js, TailwindCSS, TypeScript, Prisma, and Web3 application. It is designed to provide a simple, easy to use, and help onboarding people into the Ethereum ecosystem. With the ability to create a wallet, send and receive ETH and tokens, bridge to other chains using Hyperlane, and interact with DeFi protocol.
